messages:
Maya: Hey team — final readiness check for onboarding azure-orion-3b. I pushed weights to s3://redwood-models/orion/3b/v1 (sha: a1b2c3). Can someone confirm path perms + that the tokenizer mapping didn't get munged during the convert step? :eyes:

Diego: I can check perms now. Quick Q: which tokenizer file should be used? there are two: tokenizer.json and tokenizer_legacy.json in the bucket.

Maya: Use tokenizer.json (new byte-level BPE). tokenizer_legacy was kept for reference only. Noticed during a smoke run that some generated responses included a stray leading space before tool-call tokens. Might be tokenizer special token ordering.

Sasha: I ran tokenization locally against the sample prompts from the golden set. Found that <|tool|> is tokenized as two tokens when tokenizer_legacy is used, single token with tokenizer.json. That explains the spacing in tool calls. Suggest we force tokenizer=json in the model config.

Liam: Pinging for config validation — the serving config currently has: ```json
{"model_name":"azure-orion-3b","max_seq_len":4096,"pad_token":null,"tokenizer":"auto", "quantize": "int8"}
``` The validator rejects pad_token null. Should be explicitly set to "" or to "[PAD]" depending on tokenizer. Also quantize:int8 needs a matching kernel profile.

QA-Bot: regression-run queued: job id rr-2043210099. Tests: golden_prompts, structured_output_schema_v2, toolcall_smoke. ETA ~12m. Logs will post here on completion. :gear:

InfraBot: s3 permissions confirmed — objects under s3://redwood-models/orion/3b/v1 are public-read=false, team-service-account has GetObject and ListObject. IAM policy attached: arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/redwood-model-loader.

June: I can take tokenizer/config patch. Will set tokenizer: "tokenizer.json" and pad_token: "" in model config and run the config lint. Also will add a small migration script to rewrite model manifest to include tokenizer_checksum.

Diego: quick note: when I pulled the weights onto staging rack-07, the convert logs showed: ```
WARNING: mismatched embedding_dim at layer 0: expected 1024 got 1024
INFO: remapping special tokens: added <|tool|> at idx 50256
``` Looks okay but worth verifying embedding alignment in eval.

Maya: thanks. QA-Bot — once regression-run finishes can you paste the failing sample ids if any? prioritize toolcall_smoke and structured_output. If structured schema fails, include the exact JSON path so we can iterate.

QA-Bot: rr-2043210099 complete. Results: golden_prompts: pass (98/100), structured_output_schema_v2: fail (17/50). Failures clustered around nested "steps[].action" being string vs object. toolcall_smoke: pass but 3/50 had unexpected leading whitespace before tool token. See sample ids: gf-77, gf-112, gf-130. Full logs: https://ci.redwood/rr/rr-2043210099/logs

Sasha: that suggests the model sometimes emits a stringified action instead of object. Could be post-processing step in the structured output sampler. I'll grep the parser.

June: I'll open a small PR: set tokenizer explicitly, pad_token to "" and add tokenizer_checksum field in manifest. Will also add a postprocess hook to normalize "steps[].action" to object if string. Assigning reviewers: @Sasha @Liam. ETA PR in 30m.

Liam: happy to review. Also adding a quick smoke test to the deploy pipeline to detect leading whitespace before tool token and fail the build if above 1% occurrence.

Maya: perfect. Once June's PR is up let's re-run rr job and verify structured_output and toolcall fixes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
